{{Quote|Ropagi system, yellow-white star: Ropagi. One terrestrial planet, Ropagi II, under nominal Imperial control. High-tech ultra-pacifist civilization. Expertise in computers and Droids. All visitors must report to Off-Worlders' Quarter Starport.|Ropagi System Datafile|<ref name="TSK" />}}
The '''Ropagi system''' was a three-planet system in [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The primary was the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Ropagi/Legends|Ropagi]].

==Description==
The Ropagi system was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was one of the systems that made up the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]]. Via a short [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], called the [[Kira Run]], the Ropagi system also connected the Enarc Run with the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]]. Neighboring the Ropagi system were the [[Roldalna system/Legends|Roldalna system]] and the [[Pax system/Legends|Pax system]]. A [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipped with a Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] could reach [[Roldalna]] within thirty-nine hours and Pax within two days and eleven hours.<ref name="TSK" />

==History==
Ropagi was originally home to the war-like [[near-Human]] [[Ropagu]], but that change when the [[Kalduu]] manipulated them to a more peace-like behavior. Since then, Ropagi became a center of philosophy and pacifism. To protect themselves, the Ropagu also began to hire [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] for all their security purposes, making Ropagi II one of the largest mercenary markets in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TSK" />

The Ropagi system was rich with natural resources. The Ropagu gained their wealth without the usual ravages of industrial development. Indutrial zones were restricted to only one [[City/Legends|city]] and orbital [[Space station/Legends|stations]].<ref name="TSK" /> With the establishment of the [[Kira Run]] in [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]], which connected the system with the Harrin Trade Corridor, this economic prosperity even increased.<ref name="AJ3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> [[Ropagi/Legends|Ropagi]], the sun of the system, became known as one of the "Twin Stars of Kira."<ref name="TSK" />

==Orbital bodies==
The Ropagi system had three planets. Two of them were close two the sun, while the last one was relatively far away. Some [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomers]] suspected that there were originally two more planets in the system, but had no evidence to support this claim.<ref name="TSK" />

===Elpur===
{{Main|Elpur}}
The closest planet to the sun was [[Elpur]], a desolate searing rock.<ref name="TSK" />

===Ropagi II===
{{Main|Ropagi II}}
Ropagi was the main planet of the system, having a population of over one billion beings and was home to two native species, the Kalduu and the Ropagu. A terrestrial, pristine world, it home to philosophers and poets and one of the largest mercenary markets in the galaxy.<ref name="TSK" />

===Seltaya===
{{Main|Seltaya Minor}}
The last planet was [[Seltaya Minor|Seltaya]], a remote ice world, which has served as a pirate base for the [[Telak's Terrors]], which plagued the Enarc Run under the command of [[Kird Telak]].<ref name="TSK" />

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] placed the system in the Expansion Region, [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] mentioned a planet called Seltaya and placed it in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Both sources described Seltaya as an ice world and homebase to a group of pirates. This contradiction was solved with the publication of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the Seltaya from ''Wanted by Cracken'' to be Seltaya Major in the [[Seltaya Major system/Legends|Seltaya Major system]] and Seltaya from ''Twin Stars of Kira'' to be Seltaya Minor (or Ropagi III) in the Ropagi system.<ref name="Atlas" />
